name: sf425-reporting
description: Map a supplied NIH award ledger to draft SF425 fields, preserving accounting basis, PMS cash-field treatment, SNAP exceptions and annual/final reporting dates. Use pasted ledger text, CSV exports, award terms and PMS snapshots to draft field values and identify balances that need reconciliation. Includes a separate reporting calendar for NIH awards.
